runnable-story.text: The runnable story is one generic conformance session that executes CG21 and emits a complete candidate-bound receipt.

accepted-behavioral-authority.text: Four accepted Lean statements govern the fold transaction, keyed mint refusal, fresh-key control and active witness uniqueness.

acceptance-lines.text: The blocking lines cover the fold, fine transaction conjuncts, duplicate refusal, keyed-mint refusal, committed sequence and workflow wiring. Copies are required and have no authorized residual.

receipt-truth-contract.text: CG21 must carry complete edge evidence and honest transaction observations. The loader rejects missing fields and never invents a trace the ledger did not surface.

copies-and-non-goals.text: The inventory, runner, receipt, workflow and consumer page are synchronized. Lean, validators, simulator, request wire, naming and other edges are outside this ticket.

stop-conditions.text: A Lean conflict, missing CI command, forbidden-surface need or the four-hour wall stops affected acceptance. Nothing is stubbed and the ticket owner does not merge.
